description: European (whole-fund) distribution waterfall: management fees, return of capital, preferred return (hurdle), GP catch-up and carried interest split, with LP net multiple and the gross-to-net drag. Interactive version: https://raziel.co/tools/carried-interest-calculator

fee_years.description: Years the full fee is charged.

hurdle_pct.description: Preferred return per year, percent. 0 for no hurdle.

management_fee_pct.description: Annual management fee on commitments, percent.

mode.description: "moic" to give a gross multiple on invested capital, "proceeds" to give total exit proceeds.

step_down_fee_pct.description: Annual fee after the step-down, percent. 0 for none.

step_down_years.description: Years the step-down fee is charged.

years.description: Years from capital call to distribution.
